name: motion
title: Motion
description: Solid bindings over the vanilla motion API.

files.content:
export { MotionConfig } from "./context";
export {
  useAnimate,
  useAnimation,
  useAnimationFrame,
  useDragControls,
  useInView,
  useMotionTemplate,
  useMotionValue,
  useMotionValueEvent,
  useReducedMotion,
  useScroll,
  useSpring,
  useTime,
  useTransform,
  useVelocity,
} from "#/lib/motion/hooks";
export { motion } from "./motion";
export { AnimatePresence, useIsPresent } from "./presence";
export type {
  AnimationControls,
  DragControls,
  MotionComponentProps,
  MotionProps,
  MotionStyle,
  ReducedMotion,
  Target,
  TargetAndTransition,
  TargetResolver,
  Transition,
  Variant,
  VariantLabels,
  Variants,
} from "#/lib/motion/types";
